Name: (AT) Sideways Theodor Andrei Painting
Author: mintypuffs
Description:
Back in March of 2023, the official Eurovision website uploaded photos of Romanian representative Theodor Andrei, with most of them [url=https://eurovision.tv/gallery/theodor-andrei-romania-2023]incorrectly rotated 90 degrees[/url].  This then became a joke within the fandom.

This mod requires[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246] Alternative Textures [/url]to work.  To hang Theodor in your home, use the Paint Bucket tool from Alternative Textures on the [b]Queen of the Gem Sea [/b]painting, which can be obtained from the Furniture Catalog or the CJB Item Spawner. Then, select it from the menu.
